title: Divergence: thermite-syntax parser #29 depth guard incomplete — parse_type/parse_pattern/if-tail recursion still SIGABRTs on deep nesting

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Failing tests at thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_reaudit.rs demonstrate the divergence. The #29 fix (commit 2a8e3e3) bounds recursion via a single `expr_depth` counter incremented only in `parse_expr` (the precedence-ladder entry). Four grammar productions recurse WITHOUT routing through `parse_expr`, so the guard never sees them and deeply nested (depth 1500) input overflows the native C stack and SIGABRTs — the exact failure mode #29 claimed to close. Authority: .design/syntax/parser.md AC-4 ("No input ... causes a panic; all failures surface as SyntaxError diagnostics") + REQ-4; goal.md R-CODE-2.

Uncapped paths (each a separate failing test, each SIGABRTs independently on a 2 MiB stack):
- divergence_deep_generic_type_no_panic: parse_type self-recursion on `Option<Option<...>>` (Generic arm). surface-grammar.md REQ-8.
- divergence_deep_slice_pattern_no_panic: parse_slice_pattern -> parse_pattern cycle on `[[[...]]]`. surface-grammar.md REQ-7.
- divergence_deep_enum_pattern_no_panic: parse_path_pattern -> parse_pattern cycle on `Some(Some(...))`. surface-grammar.md REQ-7.
- divergence_deep_if_tail_no_panic: parse_block/parse_if_parts cycle on tail-position `if x==0 { <nest> } else {0}` (the construct the #30 fix added). surface-grammar.md decision 2 / ast.md REQ-6.

Root cause: the depth bound must be applied at every recursive descent re-entry (parse_type, parse_pattern, and the parse_block if-tail cycle), not only parse_expr. Tests are #[ignore]d (tracked here) because an overflow aborts the whole test binary.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Generalise the #29 expr-only recursion bound into a single shared guard so every recursive-descent family is capped, not just parse_expr. Add a guard_recursion(inner) helper backed by a unified recursion_depth counter + MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH (kept at 64). Route the four uncapped re-entries through it: parse_expr (parse_or), parse_type (Option<...> self-recursion), parse_pattern (covers both [[...]] slice and Some(Some(..)) enum cycles), and parse_if_parts (the parse_block<->parse_if_parts tail-if cycle from #30). On limit, return the existing structured SyntaxError::ExpressionTooDeep, never abort. Single file: thermite-syntax/src/parser.rs. Verify all four reaudit tests + the existing deep-paren test return on a 2 MiB stack, and depth-40 reasonable nesting still parses; then un-ignore the four reaudit tests.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fixed in f0ceb12 (single file: thermite-syntax/src/parser.rs). Root cause: the #29 depth bound lived only in parse_expr; four families recursed without routing through it. Generalised to one shared guard_recursion helper + unified recursion_depth/MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH (kept 64). Guarded re-entries: parse_expr, parse_type (Option<...>), parse_pattern (covers both [[...]] slice and Some(Some(..)) enum cycles), parse_if_parts (parse_block<->parse_if_parts tail-if). On limit returns the existing structured SyntaxError::ExpressionTooDeep — never aborts. All four divergence_reaudit tests now return on a 2 MiB stack and are un-ignored; the existing divergence_grammar deep-paren test and depth-40 reasonable nesting still parse. Gauntlet: cargo test -p thermite-syntax 16 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored (9 conformance + 3 divergence_grammar + 4 divergence_reaudit); clippy --all-targets -D warnings PASS; fmt --all --check PASS. Touched neither test assertions nor any conformance/ fixture (only the four #[ignore] attrs removed).
